name: Shadow Volume Rendering
aliases: Shadow Volume Rendering — Volumetric Shadow Maps
definition: A specialized ray marching routine that computes only the accumulated alpha (transmittance) along a ray, used to generate shadow maps or occlusion values for volume scenes.
summary: Shadow Volume Rendering precomputes lighting shadows in a 3D texture by casting rays toward the light source, differing from other methods by storing shadow data in a volume rather than using shadow maps or screen-space buffers.
